TicketEntry.title: Ticket Entry
TicketEntry.description: An entry in the lottery representing a user's ticket purchase

payoutAddress.description: The user's personal Solana address for receiving prizes

depositAddress.description: The ephemeral wallet address used for the user's deposit

timestamp.description: The ISO timestamp of when the entry was created

txHash.description: The transaction hash of the sweep from the ephemeral wallet to the vault
